known_bug_found: analysis/decode_lib.py identify() hypothesized index_reg as the divergent field (H7); actual mechanism is base_slot. Separately, splice_case.py builds the archive via decode_lib.build_archive() without --no-fast-math (matching shdump default fastMath=YES) while harness/splice_run.m compiles the identity library with fastMathEnabled=NO -- an AIR-hash mismatch that would cause PIPELINE_MISS even had H7 been confirmed. Both are successor-experiment fixes, not corrected in EXP-0084 (frozen, already captured).
note: SUPPLEMENTARY / EXPLORATORY -- NOT part of the frozen two-run gated EXP-0084 capture. result: CONFIRMED: splicing l1 base_slot 3->4 flips out from TAG_A to TAG_B; outb unchanged. base_slot (not index_reg) causally selects which dynamically-loaded pointer a device_load dereferences.
